author: Ogrey
body:
Hello guys!
The sole purpose of this thread is to see what the community thinks about the current map rotations, so all of you can give feedback on them. It doesn't matter if you like or don't like the map, if you like the map, just post saying you like it and why you do! Example:

- I like Quintus. It involves strategy, teamwork, has a plenty of monuments and the gameplay is intense!

However, do not limit yourself to posting about maps you like only, we also need feedback from maps you dislike (including the respective reason, of course). Example:

- I dislike Illegal Office. The map provides bad gameplay, it's laggy and it has too much glitches! (Don't worry too much about this one, I know it has pretty bad reputation, however I'm constantly updating it so it provides a better gameplay, thanks for your patience, and apologies from my part!)

We will take into consideration every single post, however, the most valid ones shall be given priority. We will not take into consideration posts like this:

- I hate The Division!!! remove that map now!!!
- I think Venomous should have 2 more monuments and instead of gold you should drop diamonds.
- CandylandDTM is good pls spawn killing best thing ever!!! also good map to hax on!!!

No. Just... no. Try to give as much feedback as you can. You can give feedback to as much maps as you wish, every gamemode! Thanks for you assistance, have a great time!

Here I leave you a list of maps so you can pick the ones you wish to give feedback on!

Nebula:
Small Rotations / Left Board:
Actrix, BrokenAges, BrokenWorld, CampiErbosi, CherrylandMC, ClayTDM, Divines, Formorgar, Halcyon, Honeycomb, Justice, Luar, PalmRust, Periculum, PulasTerra, Quintus, Spookghetti, Tectum, Venomous, Zalidor.
Large Rotations / Middle Board:
AbandonedPark, BleenedRings, CandylandDTM, CastleAdventure2, Curabitur, Decay, DiamondShore, Fantasy, IllegalOffice, Justice2, Mystic, Rendezvous, Rendezvous2, Rendezvous3, Sandstorm, Senex2, Senex3, Steampunk, Teres, Unix, Volcano, Wasteland, Wonderland, Yellowstone, Zao.
MCZone Rotations / Right Board:
CastleAdventure, Crusade, Decay, DustDevils, Fissura, Frostbite, Quintus, Rendezvous, RigorMortis, Senex, Senex2, Ternio, Titans, Venomous, VenomousTDM.

Nexus:
Amazon2, Archange, Arkashia, Candoria, Canyon, Castella, Ciutat, Coniculum, DragonblazePeaks, Dredmor, Flare, Ignite, MajesticSkies, Oeilvert, SandstormNexus, Scorpio, Scribblewood, TheArc, TheDivision, TheDivision2, Travincal, Vallis, VenomousNexus, WorldsEnd.

Control The Hill:
FairyHills, Forerunner, Frozen, Magma, Necro, Polarix, Quicksand, Sakura.

The Walls:
Garden, Jungle, Oz, TetrisJungle, TetrisPlains, TetrisSwamp, TheVillage, TheWalls, WildWest.

Rule 1: If you finished making your list and you wish to add more maps to it, just edit your post.
Rule 2: Please, do not go off topic... This is a serious matter in which I attempt to improve maps :)
Rule 3: It's fine if you want to reply to someone, just avoid doing it unnecessarily. Thanks!

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I haven't played some of the new maps due to my vacation unfortunately, but I can give some input on the other maps.

Diamond Shore - This might be just personal opinion, but I'm not a huge fan of this map. I think the map is a bit big and the monuments are hard to locate, especially for newer players. However, the map itself looks quite good and there are plenty of diamonds to suit everyone's needs.

Frosbite - Again, not a fan of this one. The gameplay tends to be slow at the beginning because people are too afraid of losing their diamonds, and they simply camp at the monuments. This results in 6+ diamond guys guarding the monuments and a small amount of rushing, which never goes well because all the diamond is probably taken. Very slow paced gameplay and the game only usually wins when there is a coordinated rush; a hard thing to do.

Now, more positive stuff. :)
Venomous/Venomous TDM - I'm a big fan of this map, and many others like this map as well. Simple enough to create awesome gameplay yet detailed and visually appealing enough to look great. Fun to rush on, not too hard yet not too easy; the flat sides of the mainland allow for quick wallsprinting, but the elevated monument islands allow for defenders to find you quite easily. This gives at least some challenge to rushing, but not so much to make it exceedingly difficulty and tedious. TDM brings more fast-paced action and an overall very competitive and intense atmosphere; probably the best TDM map out there.

Justice 2 - Justice was decent map. I loved it because of the Punch/Power bows, which made others hate it because of the small, open land space and easily controllable islands; a map almost designed for kill farming. The fact that the default armor was only a leather cap with a stone sword didn't help, either. Justice 2, however, changed the idea of small space and brought an expansive, simple, and elegant flair to the sequel. Lots of vast, flat area to PvP in, yet still looking varied because of the unique shapes of the islands. Well-designed towers and structures only added to the magnificence of this map.

Also, I thought Steampunk was removed? It may have come back while I was gone...

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
1st. all walls maps. please limit the build height. 256 build is crazy. It used to be 126, not sure of the current maps and   submitted map sizes, but it needs limited, spending 2 hours getting to the top using buckets is no fun, and it happens very often. I just leave those games. 

jungle - it's an older map that not many like to play anymore . Resource thin, the map has to be learned or starvation could really happen.
 
It also has a very limited play style, no brewing, no anvil, enchanting is limited, etc... Just played out.

Oz - Oz is a very well built map. One problem with it is that donators have a huge advantage ( emerald and above) the ballon shoes, the iron scarecrow and all of the upper elevation chest are easy to pick off. The map is also vey hard to learn, it's massive, underground structures , mining for days, and about 40 chests up top. It's hard to get geared in 10 min . Movement is also a concern , I find myself in water for half of my prep time, just a little frustrating. 

Garden - a very good map, 3x strength is a little op.

The walls - again , like jungle, just needs to be rotated out or less. We have played it to death, the mid bow is way op on maps that have no apples, and limited fire protection. 

Tetris maps, I like the updates that I am seeing. I am not a fan of the drop down to the mine, or the diamond blocks in mid, but that's just an opinion, not fault of the maps. Some times the fences get in the way, and a lot of the chest loot is just for filler ( ferns and ladders, etc ) stuff that just takes up inventory space, maybe should be looked at.

village - great map.
wild west - great map

guess that's about all I got. Would be nice to have more walls maps in rotation.

replies.author: Joltz_
replies.body:
Good Maps:
Senex 3: Best map ever. The teamwork is awesome trying to defend the mid, You can rush not too easy not too hard, and its a generally good map.

CherrylandMC~ This map is unlike others, it has piston bridging, TnT Cannons and Fire Aspect swords, The clouds though, They're too easy to just rush on and get the monument.

Mystic~ Even though this map has a ton of haters, This map has a great style and when there is defense, You need to go incognito :3, You need to be careful or you'll fall out of the world, and that aspect I love, the bad thing I dislike is that theres a lot of rage about "Block Lag"

Quintus~ Theres a mix of stealth and fighting you need, you either sneak past the opposing team, or fight through them.

Bad Maps:
Rendezvous 2~ Every Rendezvous map is different, this one just makes me feel, Meh, There isn't much special about this map, and defending is annoying as hell, I know its right next to spawn, but can't we just give them a better pickaxe to destroy it faster? This map really annoys me.

Decay~ The gameplay is boring! Its just bridge, get shot, Bridge, get shot, until the other team gets bored of defending one of the bridges and gives an open opportunity.

replies.body:
fully agree with the high limit, however, some new walls maps have structures higher then 126, so maybe add a high limit little bit higher (130-150?)

jungle and walls1 - as many other players said, I think they should get removed. the game-play on them are very limited, they don't look that great, and they werent created by an avicus player.

Garden, Village and Wild-West - nothing really to say, I think they are all great and have a fun game-play (btw, wild-west is not on the list)

Tetris maps - I really like the update, I think it makes each of them more unique.

and as polar said, more maps on walls rotation would be great :D

replies.body:
+1 Walls maps:
   **Oz - A delight to look at and fun to play on - like height levels, chest variations, and fights in middle section

Oz: Great map! Lots of fun pots and stuff in chests.
Tetris Jungle:Good map but I dont like how the underground is the same as all tetris maps.
Tetris Plains " "
Tetris Swamp" "
The Village Good map but I think there should be less iron in the chests. If some1 is fast enough they can get a full set of iron armor + sword+ pickaxe in the 1st minute. 
The Walls Same as the jungle. Its just not an original or very fun map
Wild west: good map. Take out strength pot in the wall tho. Also maybe another chest witch wood in it would be nice. Its annoying to have to chop up buildings.


In general I think there should be more walls maps.


Illegal Office- Its an MCPVP map. Ik its not the same one but, its legit the same exact thing. It looks just like it.
Frostbite- It takes too long. Put mons somewhere else and make the map a little more hilly and it would be good.
Abandond Park Too eZ to get the mons. Maybe have them closer to spawn to get to easier?
Fantasy TDM. nuff said
Spookegtti Night time!! Otherwise fun
Teres It needs to be night. Otherwise one of the best maps.
 


Venomous maps- They are all great. Some of the best nebula maps there are.
Tectum: One of my favorites. I love the fact the defending is no problem because the lava there is already an OP defense.
